quotes.text: MedImageEdu is built from public or de-identified radiology sources, including MedThinkVQA cases derived from peer-reviewed Eurorad teaching files

parsed.rationale: Origin is stated, and the case-selection/construction procedure is described (Appendix A.1). Licence or terms, and consent or IRB status (or an explicit 'not required'), are not stated, so the score is origin plus a partial other element.
